name: Crossmarket
justification: Cute portal insight with one-line formula, but the statement is long and the 1x1 corner case is a trap.
solution_sketch: Megan walks her n+m-2 shortest path leaving portals; Stanley walks to her start-corner portal and teleports, costing min(n,m). Answer (n-1)+(m-1)+min(n,m), except 0 for 1x1.
